tapout~.argRule: inlets = outlets = arg count, default 1 signal

sfplay~.argRule: signal outlets = channel arg + completion bang

groove~.argRule: signal outlets = second arg + sync outlet

play~.argRule: signal outlets = second arg + completion bang

matrix~.argRule: inlets = first arg, outlets = second arg + status

receive.argRule: one inlet without name, zero with name

r.argRule: one inlet without name, zero with name

unpack.argRule: outlets = arg count, value types from args

+.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg

-.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg

*.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg

/.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg

accum.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg

sel.argRule: inlets = outlets = arg count + 1, matched outlets bang

if.argRule: ports from variable and outN references

delay.argRule: inlets = second arg + 1, outlets = second arg

pipe.argRule: inlets = arg count, outlets = arg count - 1

jit.movie.argRule: jit.movie output type from output_texture attribute

trigger.argRule: outlets = arg count, outlettype from args

t.argRule: outlets = arg count, outlettype from args

split.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from numeric arguments

swap.argRule: fixed ports, outlettype from first arg
